import csv
TS='c5c4a195-9550-5cce-9ad7-50e5c66bc8c6'
rows=list(csv.reader(open(VALUES_CSV)))
# find rows for TS
data=[(r[1],float(r[2])) for r in rows[1:] if r[0]==TS]
data.sort()
print('n',len(data))
print('min ts',data[0][0],'max ts',data[-1][0])
# range
from datetime import datetime
def p(t): return datetime.fromisoformat(t)
start=p('2018-04-15T00:00:00')
end=p('2018-07-26T23:00:00')
data=[(t,v) for t,v in data if start<=p(t)<=end]
print('in-range n',len(data))
# check hourly consecutive
import datetime as dt
ok=sum(1 for i in range(1,len(data)) if (p(data[i][0])-p(data[i-1][0]))==dt.timedelta(hours=1))
print('hourly consecutive',ok,'of',len(data)-1)
occ=sum(abs(v-b) for (t,b),(u,v) in zip(data,data[1:]) if int(t[11:13]) in range(8,19))
unocc=sum(abs(v-b) for (t,b),(u,v) in zip(data,data[1:]) if int(t[11:13]) not in range(8,19))
print('occupied',occ)
print('unoccupied',unocc)
print('answer', 'occupied' if occ>unocc else 'unoccupied')
